scope: Final automated engineering checks and actual desktop browser rehearsal; not a phone test or a clinical evaluation.

automatedTests.evidence: Final release-owner test result, also recorded in docs/submission-1.0/实现与排练核对.md. This documentation update did not rerun tests.

browserRehearsal.method: Actual CUA browser interactions using fictional competition-mode inputs

checks.observed: After confirming no obvious discomfort, a low-burden support card was displayed.
Anger plus mild palpitations produced a relevant AI-selected support card and one focused safety question.
An uncertain reply retained the current support card without being converted to a clinical denial. A deployment-switch fallback was visibly labelled as basic matching.

A full 30-second action followed by improved feedback reached the improvement page. The calendar value increased from 15 to 16, daily completions from 1 to 2, and the completed card and simulated timestamp appeared.
At simulated 23:30, the selected relaxation card kept the user lying down and required no getting up.
Simulated sleep showed the quiet-night state without ordinary action-card buttons.
Explicit severe chest pain with heavy sweating immediately showed the help page and 120 link. The dial link was not activated.

deployment.note: The release owner generates a separate deployment-check.json only after verifying the published endpoints and bytes. Historical 0.9 deployment checks are not 1.0 evidence.
